74	\author{Lando Mills}
75	\date{}

77	\begin{document}
78	\maketitle
79	
80	\begin{abstract}
81	The construction is formulated on the sixteen-state space $\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\})$
82	with a non-explosive consequence relation.  This is a rebase of the logical
83	substrate, not a reinterpretation of a prior Boolean construction.  The Belnap--Dunn
84	four-state system is the $t,f$-free subspace of $\mathcal X$, and $\{F,T\}$ is a
85	further lossy restriction.
86	
87	The mathematical operations needed below are written directly with set
88	intersection and union, ordinary functions on the resulting components,
89	ordinary product coordinates for retained invariants, directed graphs, tensor
90	filtrations, and a final scalar functional.  Inter-Universal Teichm\"uller
91	Theory is then described in those terms.
92	
93	The $\Theta$-link transports arithmetic data without identifying the ring
94	structures on its two sides; the log-$\Theta$ construction retains filtration
95	position; and the bounded-discrepancy calculation terminates at $Ftf=\{F,t,f\}$
96	while its reconnection condition holds.  Cyclic phase is represented by the
97	standard action of $C_{12}$ on a twelve-position presentation.  Scholze--Stix
98	obtain a vacuous scalar inequality only after suppressing the filtration index
99	carrying the $j^2$ weights.  Mochizuki correctly rejects their commuting-loop
100	surrogate, but the stronger point is that local incompatibility is admissible
101	and non-explosive once locality and filtration position have been retained.
102	Classicalization therefore occurs only as a downstream projection of the
103	calculation.
104	\end{abstract}
105	
106	\section{Rebasing the logical substrate}
107	\label{sec:rebasing}
108	
109	The logical base used in this paper is constitutive.  It is not an optional
110	semantic gloss on a construction that is first completed in a classical
111	two-valued universe.
112	
113	A \emph{reinterpretation} leaves the underlying consequence relation and
114	admissible carrier unchanged and assigns a new description to objects already
115	formed there.  That is not the operation performed here.  The present
116	construction is \emph{rebased}: formulas, graph states, closure predicates,
117	contradictory states, filtrations, cyclic phases, and terminal scalar evaluations are
118	formed directly in the non-explosive carrier and are governed from the outset
119	by its consequence relation.
120	
121	Concretely, the base is
122	\[
123	  \mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}),
124	\]
125	together with the directed graph operations introduced below and a consequence
126	relation for which local contradiction does not entail an arbitrary conclusion:
127	\[
128	  p,\neg p\nvdash q
129	\]
130	for unrelated $q$.  States such as
131	\[
132	  A=\{T,F,t,f\},
133	  \qquad
134	  Ftf=\{F,t,f\},
135	\]
136	are therefore values of the calculation itself.  They are not annotations
137	attached after a classical computation has already finished.
138	
139	The Boolean pair
140	\[
141	  B_4=\{F,T\}
142	\]
143	appears only as a proper downstream restriction.  Classicalization is a map
144	\[
145	  \clproj:\mathcal X\longrightarrow B_4
146	\]
147	that forgets carrier information.  Hence the logical direction of the paper is
148	\[
149	  \boxed{\text{full nonclassical calculation}}
150	  \;\longrightarrow\;
151	  \boxed{\text{downstream Boolean shadow}},
152	\]
153	never the reverse.  In particular, a scalar terminal inequality may lie in a
154	classical codomain without implying that the calculation which produced it was
155	classical.

162	  \node[pcnode,right=of base,minimum width=34mm,minimum height=14mm,align=center] (read)

180	\begin{proposition}[The rebase is not a re-description]
181	The full state space and the Boolean restriction are not equivalent descriptions
182	of the same logical state space.  In particular, the classicalization map
183	$\clproj:\mathcal X\to B_4$ is non-injective and cannot preserve the
184	contradictory fixed point as a Boolean state.
185	\end{proposition}
186	
187	\begin{proof}
188	Distinct full-states have the same Boolean shadow; for example,
189	\[
190	  \clproj(\{F\})=\clproj(\{F,t,f\})=F.
191	\]
192	Moreover the contradictory state $B=\{T,F\}$ is fixed by information closure,
193	\[
194	  \Inc(B)=B,
195	\]
196	whereas every map into $B_4=\{F,T\}$ must return one of the two Boolean poles.
197	Thus classicalization loses states and operations that are native to the
198	calculation.  It cannot be an invertible change of description.

343	\section{FOUR inside the full state space}

345	The full state space contains the Belnap--Dunn FOUR slice

350	falsity only, and $B$ carries both.  Negation fixes the two nonclassical states,
351	\[

354	and exchanges the classical poles $T$ and $F$.  The crucial point is not simply
355	that FOUR has two additional labels.  It allows incompatible information to
356	remain present without identifying that state with arbitrary consequence

366	\[

368	\qquad
369	F <_{t} B <_{t} T,
370	\]
371	with $N$ and $B$ incomparable.  The same carrier therefore supports different
372	motions without forcing one motion to erase the others.  Contradiction is the
373	top of information, not a detonation command.

420	\subsection{The Boolean shore is internal and lossy}

422	Inside FOUR sits the two-element Boolean core

426	The inclusion $i:B_4\hookrightarrow\FOUR$ has, in the truth order, two canonical
427	adjoints \cite{uno}.  The reflector
428	\[
429	r:\FOUR\to B_4,
430	\qquad
431	r(F)=F,\quad r(T)=T,\quad r(N)=r(B)=T,
432	\]
433	obeys $r\dashv i$.  The coreflector
434	\[
435	c:\FOUR\to B_4,
436	\qquad
437	c(F)=F,\quad c(T)=T,\quad c(N)=c(B)=F,
438	\]
439	obeys $i\dashv c$.  Both are retractions on the Boolean image,
440	\[

442	\qquad
443	c\circ i=\operatorname{id}_{B_4},
444	\]
445	but they disagree precisely where the full state space contains information that the
446	Boolean core excludes.

448	Beside them is the paraconsistent closure
449	\[

451	\qquad
452	\Inc(v)=B.

455	\[

461	\qquad
462	B\xmapsto{c}F,
463	\qquad
464	B\xmapsto{\Inc}B.

513	\section{IUT: incompatible transport retained}
514	
515	IUT begins with initial $\Theta$-data attached to an elliptic curve over a number
516	field and constructs Hodge theaters carrying arithmetic and geometric data
517	\cite{iut1}.  The point relevant here is the relation between theaters.  The
518	$\Theta$-link relates Frobenioid-theoretic portions of one theater to another in
519	a manner that is deliberately not compatible with the respective ring/scheme
520	structures.  The ring structures on the two sides are not transported as one
521	ring structure.  The theory works instead with what it calls an \emph{alien ring
522	structure}: one side is described from the standpoint of a structure that is not
523	its own.

525	That is already a paraconsistent situation.  The link does not need to say that
526	one ring structure is secretly the other.  It needs to retain enough of both for
527	a meaningful comparison to survive their incompatibility.  The information is
528	therefore not exhausted by either classical pole.  If one insists that every
529	state be reduced to exactly $T$ or exactly $F$, the alien part of the
530	alien ring structure has been removed before the transport runs.

532	The same pattern persists in the three indeterminacies.  They are not a temporary
533	failure to identify the unique classical object that ``really'' exists.  They
534	are controlled latitude in the transport itself.  Some data are retained only
535	up to automorphism, unit action, or upper semi-compatibility.  The relevant
536	question is consequently not ``which side wins?'' but ``what is invariant while
537	incompatible or incomplete determinations remain live?''  That is the ordinary

644	\section{Indeterminacy without erasure}
645	
646	IUT's three indeterminacies are often described as the price paid for comparing
647	objects across alien structures.  They delimit the live
648	variation directly: they delimit which information is fixed and which information is
649	allowed to vary without destroying the transport.
650	
651	An underdetermined state has the shape of $N$: neither classical determination
652	is present.  An overdetermined state has the shape of $B$: both are
653	present.  These need not be globally assigned labels once and for all.  The same
654	construction can move through regions of incompleteness and regions of
655	inconsistency.  The important invariant is that neither state triggers
656	explosion, so local indeterminacy does not license arbitrary conclusions about
657	unrelated parts of the graph.
658	
659	This is why the classical restriction is not merely inconvenient.  Its two
660	canonical collapse maps identify both $N$ and $B$ with a classical pole:
661	\[
662	r(N)=r(B)=T,
663	\qquad
664	c(N)=c(B)=F.
665	\]
666	Thus incompleteness and inconsistency become indistinguishable after either
667	collapse.  IUT, by contrast, repeatedly depends on knowing what survives under a
668	specified indeterminacy.  A state-space restriction that erases the distinction between
669	``not yet determined'' and ``jointly but incompatibly determined'' cannot serve
670	as the carrier for that bookkeeping.

672	\section{Conjugate synchronization as preserved multiplicity}
673	
674	Conjugate synchronization aligns copies of the local Galois group across labels
675	so that theta evaluation can be made without introducing the conjugacy
676	indeterminacy that would otherwise obstruct the comparison.  It does not make
677	the labels one label.  It makes a family jointly readable while preserving the
678	fact that it is a family.
679	
680	Synchronization retains multiplicity.  It does not require the
681	carrier to contract all copies to one classical representative.  It requires a
682	common relation that can be carried across several simultaneously present
683	copies.  In carrier language the useful state is therefore not ``one lane has
684	won'' but ``the lanes have acquired a common image.''  The all-lane state $A$
685	is an extreme example of that phenomenon: every base atom is present in one
686	state without that state becoming trivial.
687	
688	The distinction matters because $A$ is not the statement that every proposition
689	is derivable.  It is one value of one carrier at one point in one graph.  Local
690	saturation of information is not global logical explosion.

696	or made permutation-invariant \cite{iut1,iut2}.  The full state space carries this contrast because the same carrier supports more than one

699	IUT needs simultaneous order-sensitive and order-insensitive descriptions of

701	state participate in several orderings without being duplicated into separate

705	in the log-theta-lattice changes what is being transported or forgotten, but it
706	does not require a new logical universe.  The same value can be compared under another
707	order without leaving the carrier.  The noncommutativity of
708	moves is then allowed to remain noncommutative.  There is no requirement that two
709	paths through the lattice collapse to a single Boolean equality before the
710	result can be meaningful.

712	\section{Paper I: the theater is already non-Boolean}
713	
714	Paper I constructs the Hodge theaters and the links among them \cite{iut1}.  Its
715	central act is not the production of a globally shared ring structure.  It is
716	the controlled passage among structures after precisely such a shared ring
717	structure has been relinquished.

721	are sufficiently stripped of ring rigidity to admit the link.  What survives is
722	not an equality of ringed spaces but a package of invariants that can be
723	recognized on both sides.  The alien ring structure is therefore not an
724	exception occurring after a classical construction.  It is the condition that
725	makes the inter-universal movement possible.
726	
727	Paper I establishes a carrier large enough for mutually
728	alien determinations to remain simultaneously addressable.  The mono-analytic
729	core is valuable not because it secretly reconstructs one common classical
730	ring, but because it identifies content that survives when the surrounding ring
731	structures do not coincide.  This is the same informational logic expressed by
732	FOUR: keep the information that is jointly supported, keep track of what is
733	missing or incompatible, and do not infer everything from the incompatibility.

750	Paper II develops the Hodge--Arakelov-theoretic evaluation and the Kummer theory
751	relating Frobenius-like and Galois-theoretic forms of the theta data
752	\cite{iut2}.  The crucial operation is not the elimination of multiplicity but
753	the ability to evaluate coherently across it.
754	
755	Multiradiality is an information-preserving change
756	of viewpoint.  A uniradial description is tied to one spoke; a multiradial
757	description can speak from several spokes.  What must remain fixed is the coric
758	content that survives these shifts.  The indeterminacies specify which changes
759	of representation are tolerated.  They do not designate noise to be thrown
760	away.
761	
762	Cyclotomic, discrete, and constant-multiple rigidities are useful precisely
763	because they survive the admissible spread.  A rigidity is an invariant under
764	the relevant movement.  In the carrier, there is content
765	that survives even while other atoms are added, swapped, projected, or held in
766	contradictory combination.  Information growth around an invariant is not the
767	same as loss of the invariant.
768	
769	The Gaussian Frobenioid constructions sharpen the point.  The theory can pass
770	between Frobenius-like and \`etale-like presentations of theta values without
771	requiring the two presentations to be literally identical structures.  Their
772	relation is carried by Kummer theory and the stated invariants.  The carrier retains the relation itself, not merely its two endpoints.
773	
774	\section{Paper III: the log-theta-lattice in motion}
775	
776	Paper III makes the multidirectional character of the construction explicit in
777	the log-theta-lattice \cite{iut3}.  Horizontal and vertical transports coexist.
778	The log-link and the theta-related links do not need to commute into one classical
779	identity to be usable.  Their difference is part of the geometry of the lattice.

814	direction.  The relation is one-sided where equality would demand too much.
815	The Boolean restriction has no state

820	monoids then become operational rather than apologetic.  They delimit an orbit
821	of admissible descriptions.  An invariant is something that survives that orbit.
822	The construction asks what can be transported throughout the orbit, not which
823	representative should be canonized as the one classically true object.

825	\section{Paper IV: bounded discrepancy in direct form}
826	
827	Paper IV brings the preceding transport to log-volume estimates and the
828	bounded-discrepancy inequality \cite{iut4}.  A representative form is
829	\[

831	\;\lesssim\;
832	(1+\epsilon)
833	\bigl(\log\text{-}\mathrm{diff}_X+\log\text{-}\mathrm{cond}_D\bigr).
834	\]
835	The final expression is scalar, but the information from which it is formed
836	need not be.

842	X_T=X\cap\{T\},\qquad
843	X_I=X\cap\{t,f\},\qquad
844	X_F=X\cap\{F\}.

847	instance considered here has
848	\[
849	Y_T=\varnothing,\qquad
850	Y_I=\{t,f\},\qquad
851	Y_F=\{F\}.

854	\[
855	Y_{\mathrm{bd}}
856	=
857	Y_T\cup Y_I\cup Y_F
858	=
859	\{F,t,f\}
860	=:Ftf.
861	\]

864	second coordinate,
865	\[
866	k'=\Phi(Ftf,k).
867	\]

869	\[
870	H=h(Ftf,k').

873	\[
874	H
875	\;\lesssim\;

877	\bigl(\log\text{-}\mathrm{diff}_X+\log\text{-}\mathrm{cond}_D\bigr).
878	\]
879	Thus the scalar codomain of the last line does not determine the logical state
880	space of the preceding construction.

927	\begin{proposition}[Boolean projection does not determine the preceding state]
928	The map
929	\[
930	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}:\mathcal X\to\mathcal P(\{T,F\}),
931	\qquad
932	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(X)=X\cap\{T,F\},
933	\]
934	is non-injective.
935	\end{proposition}

939	\[
940	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(\{F\})
941	=
942	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(\{F,t\})
943	=
944	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(\{F,f\})
945	=

947	=

952	\subsection{Reconnection and closure at infinity}
953	
954	Let \(G_{\mathrm{bd}}\) be the three-branch graph in
955	Figure~\ref{fig:bd-circuit}, truncated at the scalar evaluation.  Since the
956	three branches meet at the union vertex,
957	\[
958	C_{\mathrm{rec}}(G_{\mathrm{bd}})=1.
959	\]
960	
961	The finite graph has no directed edge from its terminal vertex back to its
962	initial vertex, so
963	\[
964	C_{\mathrm{ret}}(G_{\mathrm{bd}})=0.
965	\]
966	If the boundary points are identified at infinity, let
967	\(\overline G_{\mathrm{bd}}\) denote the resulting augmented graph.  Then
968	\[
969	C_{\mathrm{ret}}(\overline G_{\mathrm{bd}})=1.
970	\]
971	Thus
972	\[
973	\bigl(
974	C_{\mathrm{rec}}(G_{\mathrm{bd}}),
975	C_{\mathrm{ret}}(G_{\mathrm{bd}}),
976	C_{\mathrm{ret}}(\overline G_{\mathrm{bd}})
977	\bigr)
978	=
979	(1,0,1).
980	\]
981	These are three ordinary graph-theoretic statements.

983	\subsection{A conventional phase parameter}
984	
985	When a finite configuration is presented with a cyclic choice of cut, write
986	\[
987	C_{12}=\mathbb Z/12\mathbb Z
988	\]

991	R(k)=k+1\pmod{12}.
992	\]

994	\[
995	I(Rk)=I(k)
996	\qquad
997	\text{for all }k\in C_{12}.
998	\]
999	A quantity that fails this equation is phase-dependent.

1001	\section{From the \texorpdfstring{$\Theta$}{Theta}-link to bounded discrepancy}
1002	
1003	The two principal examples differ in their terminal states:
1004	\[
1005	A=\{T,F,t,f\},
1006	\qquad
1007	Ftf=\{F,t,f\}.
1008	\]
1009	Their common mathematical form is the elementary decomposition
1010	\[
1011	X
1012	=
1013	(X\cap\{T\})
1014	\cup
1015	(X\cap\{t,f\})
1016	\cup
1017	(X\cap\{F\}),
1018	\]
1019	followed by branchwise transformations and reunion by set union.
1020	
1021	For the \(\Theta\)-link case,
1022	\[
1023	\{T\}\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}=A.
1024	\]
1025	For the bounded-discrepancy case,
1026	\[
1027	\varnothing\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}=Ftf.
1028	\]
1029	In both cases the Boolean projection is formed only afterward:
1030	\[
1031	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(A)=B,
1032	\qquad
1033	\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(Ftf)=F.
1034	\]
1035	
1036	\section{Why the final inequality is not a return to classicality}
1037	
1038	It would be a mistake to treat the final real-valued inequality as evidence that
1039	the construction has finally returned to a Boolean restriction.  A numerical
1040	inequality can be the scalar value of a nonclassical computation.  The codomain of the
1041	last scalar estimate does not retroactively determine the carrier of
1042	the transformations that produced it.
1043	
1044	This is already visible in the bounded-discrepancy calculation.  The terminal scalar evaluation is the
1045	``logarithmic bound,'' yet the state at that anchor is $Ftf$, not $T$ or $F$.
1046	The graph can therefore end at a perfectly definite inequality while retaining
1047	non-Boolean information about how that inequality was obtained.
1048	
1049	Likewise, IUT's Diophantine conclusion does not imply that all of the
1050	inter-universal transport preceding it can be represented inside the Boolean
1051	restriction.  The final bound is a scalar shadow of a richer construction.  The
1052	shadow can be classical even when the carrier that casts it is not.
1053	
1054	\section{Species, mutation, and realization independence}
1055	
1056	Paper IV's species language extends the same principle at the set-theoretic end
1057	of the theory \cite{iut4}.  A species gives formulas that determine a category in
1058	different realizations; mutations transport the presentation; cores are
1059	what survive the mutation.  The emphasis is again on invariance across changes
1060	of realization rather than identity of all realization-level presentations.
1061	
1062	The same labeled directed graph can be realized in different mathematical
1063	contexts while its incidence structure, closure predicates, and admissible
1064	transformations remain meaningful.  This variation of realization does not
1065	vary the logical base.  Every realization remains subject to the same
1066	non-explosive consequence relation and the same full state space; realization
1067	independence is therefore not permission to return to a Boolean foundation.  Its type is carried by organized relations,
1068	not by a demand that every realization share one literal underlying object.
1069	Self-reference is carried by ordinary endomorphisms such as
1070	$\operatorname{id}:\mathcal X\to\mathcal X$ without licensing explosion.
1071	
1072	This realization-independence is structural and occurs within the rebased logical substrate.  The graph may contain
1073	maps that act on its own retained data, and those self-referential motions remain
1074	subject to exactly the same incidence and state-space laws as every other motion in
1075	the calculation.
1076	
1077	\section{What classicalization destroys}
1078	
1079	The consequences can be stated directly.  Applying a Boolean restriction to the
1080	full state space destroys at least five kinds of information used in the
1081	structure developed above:
1082	\begin{enumerate}
1083	\item It identifies $N$ and $B$ under either canonical collapse, although one is
1084	incomplete and the other inconsistent.
1085	\item It replaces a contradictory fixed point by one of two opposite classical
1086	poles.
1087	\item It removes the $t,f$ information layer from full sixteen-state states
1088	such as $Ftf$ and $A$.
1089	\item It cannot retain the operation
1090	\[
1091	X\longmapsto X\cup\{t,f\}
1092	\]
1093	inside the Boolean subspace.
1094	\item It encourages a single verdict where the construction carries several
1095	simultaneous properties: reconnection, terminal state, filtration position,
1096	and invariant content.
1097	\end{enumerate}
1098	These are not cosmetic losses.  They remove exactly the information needed to
1099	say what survives alien transport.
1100

1121	carrier.  Classical states occur whenever the state lies on the Boolean
1122	slice, but the existence of such states does not make the construction
1123	classical.  The Boolean slice is a downstream subspace of the rebased
1124	calculation, not the universe of discourse and not a prior theory waiting to be
1125	reinterpreted.

1127	\section{Continuity across the four IUT papers}
1128	
1129	The four papers form one mathematical progression without requiring a return to
1130	a common ring structure.
1131	
1132	Paper I constructs Hodge theaters and transports arithmetic data between
1133	structures that are not identified as one ring.  Paper II isolates data that
1134	remain comparable across those distinct realizations.  Paper III organizes the
1135	comparison through the log-\(\Theta\) lattice and tensor packets of log-shells.
1136	Paper IV forms log-volume and height estimates from the information that
1137	survives those transports.

1166	The recurring invariant is controlled recoverability.  Distinct contributions
1167	may be transformed differently and still remain jointly representable:
1168	\[
1169	Y=Y_T\cup Y_I\cup Y_F.
1170	\]
1171	Recovery therefore does not mean that the three terms are equal.  It means that
1172	the information required by the construction remains present in their union.

1174	\section{Scholze--Stix and the vacuity produced by tensor-blind comparison}
1175	\label{sec:ss-vacuity}
1176	
1177	The Scholze--Stix objection must be stated at full strength.  Their analysis of
1178	the passage to IUT III, Corollary 3.12 argues that the $j^2$ factors attached to
1179	the concrete $\Theta$-pilot data cannot be retained while simultaneously making
1180	what they regard as consistent identifications among the ordered real lines in
1181	which the corresponding pilot quantities are represented.  Removing those
1182	factors yields an inequality of the form
1183	\[
1184	  0 \;\lesssim\; d(P),
1185	\]
1186	which they describe as essentially free of content; under the same
1187	simplifications, they remark that the relevant multiradial theorem becomes
1188	``not false, but trivial'' \cite{ss2018}.
1189	
1190	The tensor filtration does not answer this by introducing a quotient, a collapse,
1191	or a hidden identification.  There is no such operation.  The relevant object
1192	is a \emph{tensor filtration}.  The procession of tensor packets of log-shells
1193	is retained as a filtered object, and the weights occurring at different
1194	tensor positions are read at the positions at which they occur.  Schematically,
1195	write
1196	\[
1197	  0\subseteq F_0\mathcal T\subseteq F_1\mathcal T
1198	  \subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_m\mathcal T=\mathcal T
1199	\]
1200	for the tensor filtration of the common container.  What matters is not a
1201	single scalar line on which every $j$-label must act by the same normalization,
1202	but the tensor packet together with the filtration position at which each
1203	contribution occurs.  We may record that position by the filtration degree
1204	\[
1205	  \nu_F(x):=\min\{j:x\in F_j\mathcal T\}.
1206	\]
1207	Thus the $j^2$-weight is not an extra scalar inserted into one universal real
1208	line.  It is indexed by the position $j$ of the contribution in the tensor
1209	filtration:
1210	\[
1211	  \nu_F(x)=j
1212	  \qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad
1213	  \text{the corresponding $\Theta$-contribution carries weight }j^2.
1214	\]
1215	Different $j^2$-weights at different filtration positions do not constitute
1216	monodromy of one scalar line.  They are the filtration data.
1217	
1218	This is precisely why the Scholze--Stix scalar diagram and the IUT tensor
1219	calculation ask different questions.  Scholze--Stix require the various
1220	real-valued representatives to participate in one simultaneous system of
1221	identifications and then diagnose the $j^2$-dependence as an inconsistency in
1222	that system \cite{ss2018}.  But IUT III performs the multiradial representation
1223	on regions inside tensor packets of log-shells and only afterwards forms the
1224	log-volume of the resulting holomorphic hull \cite{iut3}.  The tensor packet is
1225	not decorative bookkeeping around an underlying one-dimensional comparison;
1226	it is where the comparison lives.

\begin{abstract}
The construction is formulated on the sixteen-state space $\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\})$
with a non-explosive consequence relation.  This is a rebase of the logical
substrate, not a reinterpretation of a prior Boolean construction.  The Belnap--Dunn
four-state system is the $t,f$-free subspace of $\mathcal X$, and $\{F,T\}$ is a
further lossy restriction.

The mathematical operations needed below are written directly with set
intersection and union, ordinary functions on the resulting components,
ordinary product coordinates for retained invariants, directed graphs, tensor
filtrations, and a final scalar functional.  Inter-Universal Teichm\"uller
Theory is then described in those terms.

The $\Theta$-link transports arithmetic data without identifying the ring
structures on its two sides; the log-$\Theta$ construction retains filtration
position; and the bounded-discrepancy calculation terminates at $Ftf=\{F,t,f\}$
while its reconnection condition holds.  Cyclic phase is represented by the
standard action of $C_{12}$ on a twelve-position presentation.  Scholze--Stix
obtain a vacuous scalar inequality only after suppressing the filtration index
carrying the $j^2$ weights.  Mochizuki correctly rejects their commuting-loop
surrogate, but the stronger point is that local incompatibility is admissible
and non-explosive once locality and filtration position have been retained.
Classicalization therefore occurs only as a downstream projection of the
calculation.
\end{abstract}

\section{Rebasing the logical substrate}
\label{sec:rebasing}

The logical base used in this paper is constitutive.  It is not an optional
semantic gloss on a construction that is first completed in a classical
two-valued universe.

A \emph{reinterpretation} leaves the underlying consequence relation and
admissible carrier unchanged and assigns a new description to objects already
formed there.  That is not the operation performed here.  The present
construction is \emph{rebased}: formulas, graph states, closure predicates,
contradictory states, filtrations, cyclic phases, and terminal scalar evaluations are
formed directly in the non-explosive carrier and are governed from the outset
by its consequence relation.

Concretely, the base is
\[
  \mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}),
\]
together with the directed graph operations introduced below and a consequence
relation for which local contradiction does not entail an arbitrary conclusion:
\[
  p,\neg p\nvdash q
\]
for unrelated $q$.  States such as
\[
  A=\{T,F,t,f\},
  \qquad
  Ftf=\{F,t,f\},
\]
are therefore values of the calculation itself.  They are not annotations
attached after a classical computation has already finished.

The Boolean pair
\[
  B_4=\{F,T\}
\]
appears only as a proper downstream restriction.  Classicalization is a map
\[
  \clproj:\mathcal X\longrightarrow B_4
\]
that forgets carrier information.  Hence the logical direction of the paper is
\[
  \boxed{\text{full nonclassical calculation}}
  \;\longrightarrow\;
  \boxed{\text{downstream Boolean shadow}},
\]
never the reverse.  In particular, a scalar terminal inequality may lie in a
classical codomain without implying that the calculation which produced it was
classical.

\begin{proposition}[The rebase is not a re-description]
The full state space and the Boolean restriction are not equivalent descriptions
of the same logical state space.  In particular, the classicalization map
$\clproj:\mathcal X\to B_4$ is non-injective and cannot preserve the
contradictory fixed point as a Boolean state.
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
Distinct full-states have the same Boolean shadow; for example,
\[
  \clproj(\{F\})=\clproj(\{F,t,f\})=F.
\]
Moreover the contradictory state $B=\{T,F\}$ is fixed by information closure,
\[
  \Inc(B)=B,
\]
whereas every map into $B_4=\{F,T\}$ must return one of the two Boolean poles.
Thus classicalization loses states and operations that are native to the
calculation.  It cannot be an invertible change of description.
\end{proof}

This distinction governs every later section.  Transport without
ring-identification, controlled indeterminacy, simultaneous graph predicates,
the $t,f$ information layer, filtration position, and phase-bearing observables
are native data.  None is introduced as commentary on an underlying Boolean
calculation.

\section{Elementary set-theoretic form}
\label{sec:elementary-form}

Let
\[
\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}).
\]
All logical state manipulations used below can be written directly with
intersection, union, and ordinary functions.

For \(X\in\mathcal X\), set
\[
X_T:=X\cap\{T,t\},\qquad X_F:=X\cap\{F,f\}.
\]
Then
\[
X=X_T\cup X_F,\qquad X_T\cap X_F=\varnothing.
\]

When the information contribution is displayed separately, write
\[
X^{(T)}:=X\cap\{T\},\qquad
X^{(I)}:=X\cap\{t,f\},\qquad
X^{(F)}:=X\cap\{F\}.
\]
Hence
\[
X=X^{(T)}\cup X^{(I)}\cup X^{(F)},
\]
with pairwise disjoint terms.  The displayed order is always
\[
[T]\;|\;[t,f]\;|\;[F].
\]
The middle term is the ambient information contribution.

Polarity reversal is the ordinary involution
\[
\nu(X)=\{\sigma(a):a\in X\},
\]
where
\[
\sigma(T)=F,\quad \sigma(F)=T,\quad
\sigma(t)=f,\quad \sigma(f)=t.
\]

If an auxiliary invariant \(k\in K\) is retained, work on the product
\[
\mathcal X\times K
\]
and update only its second coordinate:
\[
(X,k)\longmapsto (X,\Phi(X,k)).
\]
The final arithmetic quantity is then an ordinary scalar function
\[
h:\mathcal X\times K\longrightarrow\mathbb R\cup\{\infty\}.
\]

\begin{proposition}[Recovery by decomposition and union]
For every \(X\in\mathcal X\),
\[
X=(X\cap\{T,t\})\cup(X\cap\{F,f\})
\]
and
\[
X=(X\cap\{T\})\cup(X\cap\{t,f\})\cup(X\cap\{F\}).
\]
\end{proposition}

\begin{proof}
The sets \(\{T,t\}\) and \(\{F,f\}\) partition
\(\{T,F,t,f\}\).  So do \(\{T\}\), \(\{t,f\}\), and \(\{F\}\).
Intersecting \(X\) with the members of either partition and taking their union
therefore recovers \(X\).
\end{proof}

If branchwise transformations \(g_T,g_I,g_F\) are applied, the transformed
state is simply
\[
Y=
g_T(X^{(T)})
\cup
g_I(X^{(I)})
\cup
g_F(X^{(F)}).
\]
Recoverability is therefore a statement about this union, not equality of the
three transformed contributions.

\subsection{The sixteen states}

Every state is a subset of $\{T,F,t,f\}$.  Hence $\mathcal X$ has sixteen
values.  The four states with no $t$ or $f$ atoms are
\[
N=\varnothing,\qquad T=\{T\},\qquad F=\{F\},\qquad B=\{T,F\}.
\]
Values containing $t$ or $f$ are not projected back into this four-state
subspace unless a separate classicalization map is explicitly applied.
The information order is ordinary inclusion,
\[
X\le_iY\quad\Longleftrightarrow\quad X\subseteq Y.
\]
Accordingly, information may accumulate without requiring a classical
resolution of contradictory support.

\section{FOUR inside the full state space}

The full state space contains the Belnap--Dunn FOUR slice
\[
\FOUR=\{N,T,F,B\},
\]
where $N$ carries neither truth nor falsity, $T$ carries truth only, $F$ carries
falsity only, and $B$ carries both.  Negation fixes the two nonclassical states,
\[
\neg N=N,\qquad \neg B=B,
\]
and exchanges the classical poles $T$ and $F$.  The crucial point is not simply
that FOUR has two additional labels.  It allows incompatible information to
remain present without identifying that state with arbitrary consequence
\cite{belnap,dunn,uno}.

The information order is
\[
N <_{i} T <_{i} B,
\qquad
N <_{i} F <_{i} B,
\]
with $T$ and $F$ incomparable.  The truth order is
\[
F <_{t} N <_{t} T,
\qquad
F <_{t} B <_{t} T,
\]
with $N$ and $B$ incomparable.  The same carrier therefore supports different
motions without forcing one motion to erase the others.  Contradiction is the
top of information, not a detonation command.

\[
v(p)=B,\qquad v(\neg p)=B,\qquad v(q)=F,
\]
and consequently
\[
p,\neg p\nvdash q.
\]
The contradiction remains local to $p$.  Nothing in the simultaneous presence
of $p$ and $\neg p$ licenses an arbitrary $q$.  This local retention is the
logical condition under which an alien structure can be carried without
collapsing the rest of the construction.

\subsection{The Boolean shore is internal and lossy}

Inside FOUR sits the two-element Boolean core
\[
B_4=\{F,T\}\subsetneq\FOUR.
\]
The inclusion $i:B_4\hookrightarrow\FOUR$ has, in the truth order, two canonical
adjoints \cite{uno}.  The reflector
\[
r:\FOUR\to B_4,
\qquad
r(F)=F,\quad r(T)=T,\quad r(N)=r(B)=T,
\]
obeys $r\dashv i$.  The coreflector
\[
c:\FOUR\to B_4,
\qquad
c(F)=F,\quad c(T)=T,\quad c(N)=c(B)=F,
\]
obeys $i\dashv c$.  Both are retractions on the Boolean image,
\[
r\circ i=\operatorname{id}_{B_4},
\qquad
c\circ i=\operatorname{id}_{B_4},
\]
but they disagree precisely where the full state space contains information that the
Boolean core excludes.

Beside them is the paraconsistent closure
\[
\Inc:\FOUR\to\FOUR,
\qquad
\Inc(v)=B.
\]
It is extensive, monotone, and idempotent in the information order, and
\[
\Inc(B)=B.
\]
The three actions on contradiction are therefore
\[
B\xmapsto{r}T,
\qquad
B\xmapsto{c}F,
\qquad
B\xmapsto{\Inc}B.
\]
The first two do not retain contradiction.  They delete it in opposite
directions.

\begin{theorem}[Boolean inexpressibility of the contradictory fixed point]
There is no endomap $f:B_4\to B_4$ satisfying
\[
i\circ f=\Inc\circ i.
\]
Equivalently, no operation internal to the Boolean core reproduces the
paraconsistent closure through the inclusion.
\end{theorem}

\begin{proof}
For any $x\in B_4$, one has $\Inc(i(x))=B$.  But $i(f(x))$ lies in
$\{F,T\}$, so $i(f(x))\neq B$.  Hence the square cannot commute.
\end{proof}

This is why the Boolean restriction is unusable wherever the
contradiction-bearing state participates in the construction.  It is
unsuitable as a carrier because $B\notin B_4$; unsuitable as a transport space
because a map into $B_4$ must discard $B$; unsuitable as a closure space because
$\Inc$ cannot factor through it; unsuitable as a record of indeterminacy because
$N$ and $B$ are exactly the values it excludes; and unsuitable as a faithful
representation because $r$ and $c$ replace one full-state by opposite classical
poles.  The Boolean world is not a competing sea.  It is an island cut out of
the sea by restriction and retraction.

\section{IUT: incompatible transport retained}

IUT begins with initial $\Theta$-data attached to an elliptic curve over a number
field and constructs Hodge theaters carrying arithmetic and geometric data
\cite{iut1}.  The point relevant here is the relation between theaters.  The
$\Theta$-link relates Frobenioid-theoretic portions of one theater to another in
a manner that is deliberately not compatible with the respective ring/scheme
structures.  The ring structures on the two sides are not transported as one
ring structure.  The theory works instead with what it calls an \emph{alien ring
structure}: one side is described from the standpoint of a structure that is not
its own.

That is already a paraconsistent situation.  The link does not need to say that
one ring structure is secretly the other.  It needs to retain enough of both for
a meaningful comparison to survive their incompatibility.  The information is
therefore not exhausted by either classical pole.  If one insists that every
state be reduced to exactly $T$ or exactly $F$, the alien part of the
alien ring structure has been removed before the transport runs.

The same pattern persists in the three indeterminacies.  They are not a temporary
failure to identify the unique classical object that ``really'' exists.  They
are controlled latitude in the transport itself.  Some data are retained only
up to automorphism, unit action, or upper semi-compatibility.  The relevant
question is consequently not ``which side wins?'' but ``what is invariant while
incompatible or incomplete determinations remain live?''  That is the ordinary
question of a paraconsistent information order.

The familiar cartoon of the alien ring structure makes the point sharply.  Take
two copies $\mathbb R_0$ and $\mathbb R_1$ and glue them by a bijection that is
not a ring homomorphism.  The underlying sets can be put into correspondence
without transporting the ring operations.  Describing algebraic information
from one copy using the ring structure of the other requires both structures to
remain present while their incompatibility is not erased.  The $\Theta$-link is
not this cartoon, but the cartoon isolates its relevant logical shape: relation
without ring-identification.

\section{Indeterminacy without erasure}

IUT's three indeterminacies are often described as the price paid for comparing
objects across alien structures.  They delimit the live
variation directly: they delimit which information is fixed and which information is
allowed to vary without destroying the transport.

An underdetermined state has the shape of $N$: neither classical determination
is present.  An overdetermined state has the shape of $B$: both are
present.  These need not be globally assigned labels once and for all.  The same
construction can move through regions of incompleteness and regions of
inconsistency.  The important invariant is that neither state triggers
explosion, so local indeterminacy does not license arbitrary conclusions about
unrelated parts of the graph.

This is why the classical restriction is not merely inconvenient.  Its two
canonical collapse maps identify both $N$ and $B$ with a classical pole:
\[
r(N)=r(B)=T,
\qquad
c(N)=c(B)=F.
\]
Thus incompleteness and inconsistency become indistinguishable after either
collapse.  IUT, by contrast, repeatedly depends on knowing what survives under a
specified indeterminacy.  A state-space restriction that erases the distinction between
``not yet determined'' and ``jointly but incompatibly determined'' cannot serve
as the carrier for that bookkeeping.

\section{Conjugate synchronization as preserved multiplicity}

Conjugate synchronization aligns copies of the local Galois group across labels
so that theta evaluation can be made without introducing the conjugacy
indeterminacy that would otherwise obstruct the comparison.  It does not make
the labels one label.  It makes a family jointly readable while preserving the
fact that it is a family.

Synchronization retains multiplicity.  It does not require the
carrier to contract all copies to one classical representative.  It requires a
common relation that can be carried across several simultaneously present
copies.  In carrier language the useful state is therefore not ``one lane has
won'' but ``the lanes have acquired a common image.''  The all-lane state $A$
is an extreme example of that phenomenon: every base atom is present in one
state without that state becoming trivial.

The distinction matters because $A$ is not the statement that every proposition
is derivable.  It is one value of one carrier at one point in one graph.  Local
saturation of information is not global logical explosion.

\section{Frobenius-like and \texorpdfstring{\'etale}{etale}-like motion}

IUT repeatedly contrasts Frobenius-like, order-conscious constructions with
\'etale-like structures in which certain ordering information has been forgotten
or made permutation-invariant \cite{iut1,iut2}.  The full state space carries this contrast because the same carrier supports more than one
order.  Nothing requires us to identify a particular IUT axis once and for all
with a particular lattice order.  The stronger and safer claim is structural:
IUT needs simultaneous order-sensitive and order-insensitive descriptions of
related data, while a bilattice/trilattice carrier is built precisely to let one
state participate in several orderings without being duplicated into separate
worlds.

This matters for the $\Theta$-link and Log-link.  A horizontal or vertical move
in the log-theta-lattice changes what is being transported or forgotten, but it
does not require a new logical universe.  The same value can be compared under another
order without leaving the carrier.  The noncommutativity of
moves is then allowed to remain noncommutative.  There is no requirement that two
paths through the lattice collapse to a single Boolean equality before the
result can be meaningful.

\section{Paper I: the theater is already non-Boolean}

Paper I constructs the Hodge theaters and the links among them \cite{iut1}.  Its
central act is not the production of a globally shared ring structure.  It is
the controlled passage among structures after precisely such a shared ring
structure has been relinquished.

The geometric and arithmetic symmetries of the labels coexist inside a theater.
The $\Theta$-link then passes from one theater to another through structures that
are sufficiently stripped of ring rigidity to admit the link.  What survives is
not an equality of ringed spaces but a package of invariants that can be
recognized on both sides.  The alien ring structure is therefore not an
exception occurring after a classical construction.  It is the condition that
makes the inter-universal movement possible.

Paper I establishes a carrier large enough for mutually
alien determinations to remain simultaneously addressable.  The mono-analytic
core is valuable not because it secretly reconstructs one common classical
ring, but because it identifies content that survives when the surrounding ring
structures do not coincide.  This is the same informational logic expressed by
FOUR: keep the information that is jointly supported, keep track of what is
missing or incompatible, and do not infer everything from the incompatibility.

\subsection{Chains of theaters}

The chain of $\Theta$-Hodge theaters is especially clear in this construction.  Each
link is a transport step whose admissibility depends on forgetting enough local
structure to move and retaining enough invariant structure to recognize the
result.  The chain does not become meaningful by restoring a single global ring
at every step.  It becomes meaningful because each step has a controlled
interface.

A theater need expose only the structure required for the next comparison.
The common data define the domain on which the next map is meaningful; no
global identification of the surrounding ring structures is required.

\section{Paper II: evaluation across alien descriptions}

Paper II develops the Hodge--Arakelov-theoretic evaluation and the Kummer theory
relating Frobenius-like and Galois-theoretic forms of the theta data
\cite{iut2}.  The crucial operation is not the elimination of multiplicity but
the ability to evaluate coherently across it.

Multiradiality is an information-preserving change
of viewpoint.  A uniradial description is tied to one spoke; a multiradial
description can speak from several spokes.  What must remain fixed is the coric
content that survives these shifts.  The indeterminacies specify which changes
of representation are tolerated.  They do not designate noise to be thrown
away.

Cyclotomic, discrete, and constant-multiple rigidities are useful precisely
because they survive the admissible spread.  A rigidity is an invariant under
the relevant movement.  In the carrier, there is content
that survives even while other atoms are added, swapped, projected, or held in
contradictory combination.  Information growth around an invariant is not the
same as loss of the invariant.

The Gaussian Frobenioid constructions sharpen the point.  The theory can pass
between Frobenius-like and \`etale-like presentations of theta values without
requiring the two presentations to be literally identical structures.  Their
relation is carried by Kummer theory and the stated invariants.  The carrier retains the relation itself, not merely its two endpoints.

Paper III makes the multidirectional character of the construction explicit in
the log-theta-lattice \cite{iut3}.  Horizontal and vertical transports coexist.
The log-link and the theta-related links do not need to commute into one classical
identity to be usable.  Their difference is part of the geometry of the lattice.

contain another without being equal to it, and additional information can be
present without invalidating what was already present.

The upper semi-compatibility of the log-Kummer correspondence has that
direction.  The relation is one-sided where equality would demand too much.
The Boolean restriction has no state
for the distinction between exact coincidence and a controlled containment that
retains extra information.  The full state space does.

The three indeterminacies of the multiradial logarithmic Gaussian procession
monoids then become operational rather than apologetic.  They delimit an orbit
of admissible descriptions.  An invariant is something that survives that orbit.
The construction asks what can be transported throughout the orbit, not which
representative should be canonized as the one classically true object.

These are three ordinary graph-theoretic statements.

When a finite configuration is presented with a cyclic choice of cut, write

A quantity \(I\) is phase-invariant precisely when

A quantity that fails this equation is phase-dependent.

The two principal examples differ in their terminal states:
\[
A=\{T,F,t,f\},
\qquad
Ftf=\{F,t,f\}.
\]
Their common mathematical form is the elementary decomposition
\[

=
(X\cap\{T\})
\cup
(X\cap\{t,f\})
\cup
(X\cap\{F\}),
\]
followed by branchwise transformations and reunion by set union.

For the \(\Theta\)-link case,
\[
\{T\}\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}=A.
\]
For the bounded-discrepancy case,
\[
\varnothing\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}=Ftf.
\]
In both cases the Boolean projection is formed only afterward:
\[
\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(A)=B,
\qquad
\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(Ftf)=F.
\]

\section{Why the final inequality is not a return to classicality}

It would be a mistake to treat the final real-valued inequality as evidence that
the construction has finally returned to a Boolean restriction.  A numerical
inequality can be the scalar value of a nonclassical computation.  The codomain of the
last scalar estimate does not retroactively determine the carrier of
the transformations that produced it.

This is already visible in the bounded-discrepancy calculation.  The terminal scalar evaluation is the
``logarithmic bound,'' yet the state at that anchor is $Ftf$, not $T$ or $F$.
The graph can therefore end at a perfectly definite inequality while retaining
non-Boolean information about how that inequality was obtained.

Likewise, IUT's Diophantine conclusion does not imply that all of the
inter-universal transport preceding it can be represented inside the Boolean
restriction.  The final bound is a scalar shadow of a richer construction.  The
shadow can be classical even when the carrier that casts it is not.

\section{Species, mutation, and realization independence}

Paper IV's species language extends the same principle at the set-theoretic end
of the theory \cite{iut4}.  A species gives formulas that determine a category in
different realizations; mutations transport the presentation; cores are
what survive the mutation.  The emphasis is again on invariance across changes
of realization rather than identity of all realization-level presentations.

The same labeled directed graph can be realized in different mathematical
contexts while its incidence structure, closure predicates, and admissible
transformations remain meaningful.  This variation of realization does not
vary the logical base.  Every realization remains subject to the same
non-explosive consequence relation and the same full state space; realization
independence is therefore not permission to return to a Boolean foundation.  Its type is carried by organized relations,
not by a demand that every realization share one literal underlying object.
Self-reference is carried by ordinary endomorphisms such as
$\operatorname{id}:\mathcal X\to\mathcal X$ without licensing explosion.

This realization-independence is structural and occurs within the rebased logical substrate.  The graph may contain
maps that act on its own retained data, and those self-referential motions remain
subject to exactly the same incidence and state-space laws as every other motion in
the calculation.

\section{What classicalization destroys}

The consequences can be stated directly.  Applying a Boolean restriction to the
full state space destroys at least five kinds of information used in the
structure developed above:
\begin{enumerate}
\item It identifies $N$ and $B$ under either canonical collapse, although one is
incomplete and the other inconsistent.
\item It replaces a contradictory fixed point by one of two opposite classical
poles.
\item It removes the $t,f$ information layer from full sixteen-state states
such as $Ftf$ and $A$.
\item It cannot retain the operation
\[
X\longmapsto X\cup\{t,f\}
\]
inside the Boolean subspace.
\item It encourages a single verdict where the construction carries several
simultaneous properties: reconnection, terminal state, filtration position,
and invariant content.
\end{enumerate}
These are not cosmetic losses.  They remove exactly the information needed to
say what survives alien transport.

The four papers form one mathematical progression without requiring a return to
a common ring structure.

Paper I constructs Hodge theaters and transports arithmetic data between
structures that are not identified as one ring.  Paper II isolates data that
remain comparable across those distinct realizations.  Paper III organizes the
comparison through the log-\(\Theta\) lattice and tensor packets of log-shells.
Paper IV forms log-volume and height estimates from the information that
survives those transports.

the information required by the construction remains present in their union.

\section{Scholze--Stix and the vacuity produced by tensor-blind comparison}
\label{sec:ss-vacuity}

The Scholze--Stix objection must be stated at full strength.  Their analysis of
the passage to IUT III, Corollary 3.12 argues that the $j^2$ factors attached to
the concrete $\Theta$-pilot data cannot be retained while simultaneously making
what they regard as consistent identifications among the ordered real lines in
which the corresponding pilot quantities are represented.  Removing those
factors yields an inequality of the form
\[
  0 \;\lesssim\; d(P),
\]
which they describe as essentially free of content; under the same
simplifications, they remark that the relevant multiradial theorem becomes
``not false, but trivial'' \cite{ss2018}.

The tensor filtration does not answer this by introducing a quotient, a collapse,
or a hidden identification.  There is no such operation.  The relevant object
is a \emph{tensor filtration}.  The procession of tensor packets of log-shells
is retained as a filtered object, and the weights occurring at different
tensor positions are read at the positions at which they occur.  Schematically,
write
\[
  0\subseteq F_0\mathcal T\subseteq F_1\mathcal T
  \subseteq\cdots\subseteq F_m\mathcal T=\mathcal T
\]
for the tensor filtration of the common container.  What matters is not a
single scalar line on which every $j$-label must act by the same normalization,
but the tensor packet together with the filtration position at which each
contribution occurs.  We may record that position by the filtration degree
\[
  \nu_F(x):=\min\{j:x\in F_j\mathcal T\}.
\]
Thus the $j^2$-weight is not an extra scalar inserted into one universal real
line.  It is indexed by the position $j$ of the contribution in the tensor
filtration:
\[
  \nu_F(x)=j
  \qquad\Longrightarrow\qquad
  \text{the corresponding $\Theta$-contribution carries weight }j^2.
\]
Different $j^2$-weights at different filtration positions do not constitute
monodromy of one scalar line.  They are the filtration data.

This is precisely why the Scholze--Stix scalar diagram and the IUT tensor
calculation ask different questions.  Scholze--Stix require the various
real-valued representatives to participate in one simultaneous system of
identifications and then diagnose the $j^2$-dependence as an inconsistency in
that system \cite{ss2018}.  But IUT III performs the multiradial representation
on regions inside tensor packets of log-shells and only afterwards forms the
log-volume of the resulting holomorphic hull \cite{iut3}.  The tensor packet is
not decorative bookkeeping around an underlying one-dimensional comparison;
it is where the comparison lives.

\subsection{Boolean projection is necessarily downstream}

Let
\[
F:\mathcal D\longrightarrow\mathcal X
\]
be any construction whose output may contain \(t\) or \(f\), and let
\[
P=\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}\circ F:
\mathcal D\longrightarrow\mathcal P(\{T,F\}).
\]
Since \(\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}\) is non-injective, \(P(d)\) cannot in general
determine \(F(d)\).

For example,
\[
F(d)=Ftf
\quad\Longrightarrow\quad
P(d)=F,
\]
but the same Boolean value is obtained from the strictly smaller state
\(\{F\}\).  A Boolean output is therefore compatible with several distinct
preceding nonclassical states.  Projection is a downstream loss of information,
not evidence that the preceding construction had a Boolean base.

the differences that generate the estimate to disappear before they are
measured.  In the language developed throughout this paper, the information is
carried through the relation rather than normalized away prior to the evaluation.


\section{Mathematical commitments}

The formulation makes concrete claims that can be checked directly.

First,
\[
X
=
(X\cap\{T\})
\cup
(X\cap\{t,f\})
\cup
(X\cap\{F\}).
\]
Any asserted terminal state must therefore contain exactly the atoms claimed for
it.

Second, any reconnection claim must follow from the directed edges of the graph.
A return claim for a finite graph and a return claim after boundary
identification at infinity are distinct predicates and must be checked
separately.

Third, if a cyclic presentation \(C_m\) is used, an invariant \(I\) must satisfy
\[
I(k+1)=I(k)
\qquad
\text{for every }k\in C_m.
\]

Fourth, the tensor weights in Paper III remain indexed by filtration position
until the scalar estimate is formed.  Suppressing that index before comparison
changes the function being evaluated.

Non-explosion weakens none of these obligations.  It prevents a local
contradiction from entailing arbitrary statements; it does not excuse an
incorrect set equality, graph edge, filtration index, or arithmetic estimate.

\section{Conclusion}

The construction developed here is a rebasing of the logical substrate, not a
reinterpretation of a prior Boolean construction.  Its state space is
\[
\mathcal X=\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\}),
\]
with FOUR as the \(t,f\)-free subspace and \(\{F,T\}\) as a further lossy
restriction.

The essential operations reduce to ordinary mathematics.  Intersection
isolates the \(T\)-, \([t,f]\)-, and \(F\)-contributions; ordinary functions
transform those contributions; union reunites them; auxiliary invariants occupy
ordinary product coordinates; and the final height estimate is a scalar
function evaluated only after the nonclassical state has been formed.

For the \(\Theta\)-link example,
\[
\{T\}\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}
=
\{T,F,t,f\}=A.
\]
For the bounded-discrepancy example,
\[
\varnothing\cup\{t,f\}\cup\{F\}
=
\{F,t,f\}=Ftf.
\]
Their Boolean projections,
\[
\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(A)=B,
\qquad
\pi_{\mathrm{cl}}(Ftf)=F,
\]
are strictly less informative than the states from which they arise.

The same principle governs the response to Scholze--Stix.  Tensor weights such
as \(j^2\) occur at specified filtration positions.  A scalar comparison that
forgets those positions may become vacuous, but the vacuity of that
position-insensitive expression does not establish the vacuity of the filtered
expression.

Mochizuki is correct that the \(\Theta\)- and \(q\)-side structures should not
be identified in the way required by the Scholze--Stix loop.  The stronger
point is that the reason is preservation of locality and filtration data, not a
foundational need to eliminate contradiction.  Local incompatibility is
admissible so long as the consequence relation remains non-explosive.

The resulting formulation is therefore conventional in notation while
remaining nonclassical in foundation.  Set intersection, union, ordinary
functions, directed graphs, cyclic groups, filtrations, and scalar inequalities
are sufficient to display the construction.  No Boolean restriction is ever
promoted to the logical base from which the richer states are subsequently
``reinterpreted.''

## Review of `/home/mrnob0dy666/imsgct/ig-docs/iutt.tex`

**Title:** "Inter-Universal Teichmüller Theory: A Paraconsistent Formulation in Conventional Mathematical Notation," author Lando Mills, `\date{}` is empty (no date field set at all — not even blank-but-present, the command exists but supplies nothing).

### 1. What the paper actually claims

The paper does **not** claim to prove the ABC conjecture, and it does not claim a new proof or repair of Mochizuki's IUT argument. Its actual thesis is foundational/expository: that IUT's transport structures (the Θ-link, indeterminacies, conjugate synchronization, the log-theta-lattice, bounded-discrepancy inequality) are naturally described by a 16-state paraconsistent logic (built as $\mathcal P(\{T,F,t,f\})$, containing Belnap–Dunn FOUR as a sub-slice and classical $\{T,F\}$ as a further lossy quotient), and that describing them this way is a "rebasing" rather than a "reinterpretation." Section 15 (Scholze–Stix) is the closest thing to a substantive mathematical contribution: it argues that the Scholze–Stix "vacuity" objection to Corollary 3.12 works by collapsing a filtration-indexed $j^2$ weight into one scalar comparison, and that this scalar vacuity does not by itself imply the filtered (unsuppressed) calculation is vacuous. But the paper is explicit that this does not settle anything: "This proposition does not establish Corollary 3.12 by itself. It identifies the burden that a non-vacuous objection must meet." (line 1430–1432). No filtered calculation is actually carried out; no demonstration is given that the $j^2$-weighted information survives in Mochizuki's actual proof.

So, precisely: this is a **structural/logical diagnosis of a meta-mathematical dispute**, not a proof, not a conditional result, and not numerical/computational evidence. The formally proved statements in the file (see below) are elementary set-theoretic facts about the author's own state-space apparatus (e.g., non-injectivity of a projection map, a trivial three-part partition identity) — not results about elliptic curves, number fields, Frobenioids, or the ABC inequality itself. The paper should not be read, and does not present itself in its actual theorem statements, as making any progress on ABC; its only relation to ABC is atmospheric/expository (restating IUT's papers I–IV in prose) plus one very general, self-admittedly inconclusive remark about the SS objection.

### 2. Structural completeness

- **Abstract before notation, stating the central distinction:** Yes — the abstract (lines 80–104) states the "rebase, not reinterpretation" distinction up front, before any formal notation is introduced in Section 1.
- **Named/numbered boxed theorems:** Yes, via `\newtheorem`. There is one `theorem` (line 489, "Boolean inexpressibility of the contradictory fixed point"), four `proposition`s, one `observation`. All are proved in short prose+display proofs immediately following (lines 187–199, 276–281, 498–501, 937–950, 1420–1428). The proofs are legitimate for what they claim, but what they claim is uniformly elementary (non-injectivity of a restriction map, a partition-union identity, a Galois-connection non-commuting-square fact). None of the "theorems" are about IUT's actual arithmetic geometry.
- **Prose vs. hand-waving:** The formal Propositions/Theorem have real (if trivial) displayed proofs. But the bulk of the IUT-specific content (Sections 6–14, "Paper I" through "Paper IV") is expository prose narrating Mochizuki's papers in the author's vocabulary, with no independent derivation — assertions like "The chain of Θ-Hodge theaters is especially clear in this construction" are stated, not established.
- **Status statement (settled vs. open):** There is no dedicated "what's settled / what's open" statement. The Conclusion (Section 16, lines 1484–1537) restates the rebase thesis and the SS response but does not explicitly flag that Corollary 3.12 / the ABC conjecture remain open in this account. The one honest disclaimer about scope (line 1430) is buried in Section 15, not surfaced in the abstract or conclusion — an editing gap if the goal is intellectual honesty about what's proved.
- **Bibliography of primary literature:** Yes (lines 1539–1581): Belnap, Dunn, Mochizuki's IUT I–IV, Mochizuki's two 2018/2019 responses to Scholze–Stix, and the Scholze–Stix manuscript itself. Also includes a self-citation: `\bibitem{uno} C. Lando Mills, \emph{UNO Reverse}, August 31, 2026.` — an unpublished/companion manuscript by the same author, cited to justify the adjoint-functor (reflector/coreflector) claims in Section 3.2. Worth flagging to an editor: self-citing an apparently unpublished companion piece for load-bearing definitions is a soft dependency risk.

### 3. House-style violations

I grepped the full file for file paths, branch names, Lean-style identifiers, module names, and dev-process narration. **None found.** No `/home/...` paths, no `.lean` references, no git/branch/commit language, no "as we saw earlier," "this was fixed," "in the previous draft," etc. The prose is self-contained mathematical exposition throughout.

One soft flag: an unrendered LaTeX **comment block** at lines 565–571:
```
% OPTIONAL MANUAL FIGURE SPECIFICATION — detailed Theta-link plate:
% Draw two Hodge-theater disks or sheets, each with its own local ring/scheme
% structure indicated by a distinct multiplication web. ...
```
This doesn't compile into the PDF and isn't "narration of what was wrong before," but it is a production/editorial instruction left inside the manuscript source (an artist/figure-commissioning note). If the house style wants the `.tex` source itself free of any meta-production commentary (not just the rendered output), this is the one thing to clean up.

### 4. Mathematical gaps

- **Undefined/underdetermined terms used casually:** "alien ring structure," "multiradiality," "coric content," "Gaussian Frobenioid," "log-shell," "upper semi-compatibility" are all used descriptively (Sections 6, 12–14) without formal definition in this file — they're imported by reference to Mochizuki's papers (`\cite{iut1,iut2,iut3,iut4}`) rather than defined here. That's acceptable for an expository paper about IUT, but it means none of these terms actually participate in the file's own proved propositions — the formal apparatus (the 16-state space, the propositions/theorem) never touches them rigorously; they only appear in prose paragraphs.
- **The central figurative device (the "sixteen-state space" and the $\Theta$-link/bounded-discrepancy "computations") is not actually a computation on IUT's real objects.** E.g., Section 8's "$\Theta$-link" example simply *posits* $Y_T=\{T\}, Y_I=\{t,f\}, Y_F=\{F\}$ (line 593–598) and Section 12's bounded-discrepancy example simply *posits* $Y_T=\varnothing, Y_I=\{t,f\}, Y_F=\{F\}$ (lines 849–852) — these are stipulated illustrative assignments, not derived from any actual property of the Θ-link or the bounded-discrepancy inequality. The subsequent "proofs" (non-injectivity of $\pi_{cl}$, the reconnection triple $(1,0,1)$) are then just formal consequences of these stipulated set memberships, not results about the actual mathematics of IUT.
- **Proposition (Filtered non-vacuity), Section 15 (lines 1411–1428):** this is essentially a tautology about information-forgetting maps ("if you evaluate insensitively to an index, you may lose distinctions that depend on that index") dressed as an answer to Scholze–Stix. Its proof (lines 1420–1428) is a restatement of the hypothesis, not a substantive argument, and the paper itself concedes right after (line 1430) that it doesn't establish the disputed corollary. This is honest, but an editor should note the proposition is far weaker than its surrounding rhetorical framing ("The resulting answer to Scholze–Stix is therefore stronger than Mochizuki's published answer," line 1399) suggests.
- **No numerical/computational content anywhere** — the paper contains zero numerics, no explicit bounds, no computed examples with actual number fields or elliptic curves. All "arithmetic" content is symbolic placeholders (e.g., $\mathrm{ht}_{\omega_X(D)} \lesssim (1+\epsilon)(\log\text{-diff}_X + \log\text{-cond}_D)$, line 830–834, quoted schematically from Mochizuki with no computation behind it in this file).
- The graph-theoretic "reconnection" apparatus ($C_{\mathrm{rec}}, C_{\mathrm{ret}}$, lines 952–981) is introduced and used but never formally defined anywhere in the file — these functionals are applied to a specific graph without a general definition of what $C_{\mathrm{rec}}$/$C_{\mathrm{ret}}$ mean for an arbitrary directed graph. This is a genuine forward-reference/gap: the reader is told the values $(1,0,1)$ hold "since the three branches meet at the union vertex" and "the finite graph has no directed edge... back to its initial vertex" — informal justifications standing in for a real definition-then-theorem structure.

### 5. LaTeX health

I actually compiled the file with `xelatex` (two passes, in scratch space, not touching the repo). **It compiles cleanly.** First pass: exit 0, 21 pages, only the expected "Citation/Reference undefined" warnings (normal before the `.aux` file exists). Second pass: exit 0, no more undefined-citation or undefined-reference warnings, only two benign `Underfull \hbox` warnings (lines 694–703 and 827–829) and standard `unicode-math` package notices. Fonts `Linux Libertine O`, `TeX Gyre Pagella Math`, and the custom `Trabajo` family all loaded without substitution warnings. `\begin`/`\end` environment counts all balance exactly. All 10 `\cite{}` keys used in the text have matching `\bibitem{}` entries, and all `\bibitem` entries are cited at least once.

Minor cleanliness (non-blocking) issues:
- 17 `\label{}`s defined (mostly figures) but only **one** `\ref{}` used anywhere (`fig:bd-circuit`, line 955). The other 16 figures/sections are never cross-referenced by number in the prose — readers must locate them by proximity, and the numbering machinery is mostly inert.
- Three unused macros defined but never invoked in the body: `\SIX` (line 68, meant as `\mathcal X`), `\BOOL` (line 67), `\impliespc` (line 71). `\sh{}`/`\shaw` (lines 9–10, the Trabajo-font command) is also defined but never used anywhere. Harmless dead code, but worth pruning.

### 6. Relationship to the companion file `iutt_fully_conventional.tex`

I did not read that file, per instructions, but from `iutt.tex`'s own internal cues: the title of this file is *already* "...A Paraconsistent Formulation in **Conventional Mathematical Notation**," and its abstract and conclusion repeatedly stress that the construction is "conventional in notation while remaining nonclassical in foundation" (line 1532–1533) and that "the essential operations reduce to ordinary mathematics" (line 1494). This is very close in framing to what a file named `iutt_fully_conventional.tex` would promise, and a directory listing shows a whole family of near-duplicate drafts sitting alongside it: `iutt2.tex`, `iutt_in_the_paraconsistent_ambient.tex`, `iutt_visual.tex`, `iuttx.tex`, `iuttxx.tex`, `iuttxxx.tex`, `iutt_fully_conventional.tex` — all in the same directory, all evidently iterative drafts of the same paraconsistent-IUT idea (the `x`/`xx`/`xxx` naming suggests successive revision passes). This file (`iutt.tex`) carries no internal version/date marker (`\date{}` is blank, no "draft," "v2," or revision note anywhere in the text), so there is no internal signal establishing it as definitively earlier or later than `iutt_fully_conventional.tex` — but the title/abstract content strongly suggests they are alternate drafts of the same underlying manuscript, and the other reviewer should be told this file already uses the phrase "conventional notation" as its own subtitle, so substantial overlap/duplication between the two files should be expected rather than treated as a surprise finding.
